name: Chaplain on Bike
unitComposition:
• 1 Chaplain on Bike model
\rThis model is equipped with: 1 Absolvor Bolt Pistol; 1 Crozius Arcanum; 1 Twin Bolt Rifle.

abilities.lore: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.
abilities.name: Leader
abilities.rules: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it. See Attached Units (19)

abilities.name: Catechism of Fire
abilities.rules: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can select one visible enemy unit. This unit’s ranged attacks that target that unit have [Devastating Wounds].

rules.name: Leader
rules.rules:
This model can be attached to the following units:

■ **OUTRIDER SQUAD**
■ **RAVENWING BLACK KNIGHTS**

abilities.name: RAPID FIRE 2
abilities.rules: This ability always takes the form [RAPID FIRE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [RAPID FIRE] weapon, add X additional attack dice if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step.\n\nExample: If a [RAPID FIRE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).

abilities.name: TWIN-LINKED
abilities.rules: Each time an attack is made with a [TWIN‑LINKED] weapon, you can re‑roll the wound roll.

abilities.name: CLEAVE 1
abilities.rules: This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down).\n\nExample: If a [CLEAVE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets one unit containing 16 models, you would gather three additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of six for that weapon).

abilities.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS
abilities.rules:
Units containing one or more models with a [CLOSE‑QUARTERS] weapon can shoot using close‑quarters shooting (10.06).\n\nWhen using another shooting type, for each model in that unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models), you can only select one of the following to make attacks with:
  • One or more of its [CLOSE‑QUARTERS] weapons.
  • One or more of its other ranged weapons.
